---
title: "Generate Access Token"
api: "POST /auth/token"
description: "Generate an access token for external API authentication using Basic Authentication"
---

Generate an access token for external API authentication. This endpoint allows third-party applications and external services to obtain a Bearer token for authenticating with Weir AI's external APIs.

<Note>
  **External API Endpoint**
  
  This endpoint is part of the External API category and requires Basic Authentication. It's designed for third-party integrations and external services that need to access Weir AI's NIL detection capabilities.
</Note>

## Authentication

This endpoint requires Basic Authentication. Include your username and password in the Authorization header:

```bash
Authorization: Basic <base64_encoded_credentials>
```

## Request

No request body is required for this endpoint. The authentication is handled through the Authorization header.

## Response

<ResponseField name="success" type="boolean">
  Indicates if the request was successful
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="data" type="object">
  Contains the access token information
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="data.access_token" type="string">
  JWT access token for API authentication
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="data.token_type" type="string">
  Token type, always "Bearer"
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="data.expires_in" type="integer">
  Token expiration time in seconds (typically 3600 = 1 hour)
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="message" type="string">
  Human-readable message about the operation result
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="timestamp" type="string">
  ISO 8601 timestamp of the response
</ResponseField>

## Example Request

<CodeGroup>
```bash cURL
curl -X POST "https://external.example.com/auth/token" \
  -H "Authorization: Basic dXNlcm5hbWU6cGFzc3dvcmQ=" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

```javascript JavaScript
const response = await fetch('https://external.example.com/auth/token', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'Authorization': 'Basic ' + btoa('username:password'),
    'Content-Type': 'application/json'
  }
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```

```python Python
import requests
import base64

# Encode credentials
credentials = base64.b64encode(b'username:password').decode('utf-8')

response = requests.post(
    'https://external.example.com/auth/token',
    headers={
        'Authorization': f'Basic {credentials}',
        'Content-Type': 'application/json'
    }
)

print(response.json())
```

```php PHP
<?php
$credentials = base64_encode('username:password');

$response = file_get_contents('https://external.example.com/auth/token', false, stream_context_create([
    'http' => [
        'method' => 'POST',
        'header' => [
            'Authorization: Basic ' . $credentials,
            'Content-Type: application/json'
        ]
    ]
]));

$data = json_decode($response, true);
print_r($data);
?>
```

```go Go
package main

import (
    "bytes"
    "encoding/base64"
    "encoding/json"
    "fmt"
    "net/http"
)

func main() {
    credentials := base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte("username:password"))
    
    req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", "https://external.example.com/auth/token", nil)
    req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Basic "+credentials)
    req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
    
    client := &http.Client{}
    resp, _ := client.Do(req)
    defer resp.Body.Close()
    
    var result map[string]interface{}
    json.NewDecoder(resp.Body).Decode(&result)
    fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result)
}
```
</CodeGroup>

## Usage Notes

<AccordionGroup>
  <Accordion title="Token Lifecycle" icon="clock">
    Token management:
    
    - Access tokens expire after 1 hour (3600 seconds)
    - Store tokens securely in your application
    - Implement token refresh logic before expiration
    - Never expose tokens in client-side code
  </Accordion>
  
  <Accordion title="Security Best Practices" icon="shield">
    Security recommendations:
    
    - Use HTTPS for all API requests
    - Store credentials securely (environment variables)
    - Implement proper error handling
    - Monitor token usage and expiration
  </Accordion>
  
  <Accordion title="Rate Limiting" icon="tachometer">
    Rate limit information:
    
    - Token generation is rate limited
    - Typical limit: 10 requests per minute per IP
    - Use exponential backoff for retries
    - Monitor rate limit headers in responses
  </Accordion>
  
  <Accordion title="Integration Examples" icon="code">
    Common integration patterns:
    
    - **Web Applications**: Server-side token generation
    - **Mobile Apps**: Secure credential storage
    - **Microservices**: Service-to-service authentication
    - **Batch Processing**: Scheduled token refresh
  </Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

## Code Examples

<AccordionGroup>
  <Accordion title="Token Manager Class" icon="cog">
    ```javascript
    class WeirTokenManager {
      constructor(username, password, baseUrl) {
        this.username = username;
        this.password = password;
        this.baseUrl = baseUrl;
        this.accessToken = null;
        this.tokenExpiry = null;
      }
      
      async getValidToken() {
        if (!this.accessToken || this.isTokenExpired()) {
          await this.generateNewToken();
        }
        return this.accessToken;
      }
      
      async generateNewToken() {
        try {
          const credentials = btoa(`${this.username}:${this.password}`);
          const response = await fetch(`${this.baseUrl}/auth/token`, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
              'Authorization': `Basic ${credentials}`,
              'Content-Type': 'application/json'
            }
          });
          
          if (!response.ok) {
            throw new Error(`Token generation failed: ${response.status}`);
          }
          
          const data = await response.json();
          this.accessToken = data.data.access_token;
          this.tokenExpiry = Date.now() + (data.data.expires_in * 1000);
          
          return this.accessToken;
          
        } catch (error) {
          console.error('Error generating token:', error);
          throw error;
        }
      }
      
      isTokenExpired() {
        if (!this.tokenExpiry) return true;
        return Date.now() >= this.tokenExpiry - 60000; // Refresh 1 minute early
      }
      
      async makeAuthenticatedRequest(endpoint, options = {}) {
        const token = await this.getValidToken();
        
        return fetch(`${this.baseUrl}${endpoint}`, {
          ...options,
          headers: {
            'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`,
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            ...options.headers
          }
        });
      }
    }
    
    // Usage example
    const tokenManager = new WeirTokenManager(
      'your_username',
      'your_password',
      'https://external.example.com'
    );
    
    // Make authenticated requests
    const response = await tokenManager.makeAuthenticatedRequest('/api/some-endpoint');
    ```
  </Accordion>
  
  <Accordion title="Python Client" icon="python">
    ```python
    import requests
    import base64
    import time
    from typing import Optional
    
    class WeirAPIClient:
        def __init__(self, username: str, password: str, base_url: str):
            self.username = username
            self.password = password
            self.base_url = base_url
            self.access_token: Optional[str] = None
            self.token_expiry: Optional[float] = None
        
        def _encode_credentials(self) -> str:
            """Encode credentials for Basic Authentication"""
            credentials = f"{self.username}:{self.password}"
            return base64.b64encode(credentials.encode()).decode()
        
        def _is_token_expired(self) -> bool:
            """Check if the current token is expired"""
            if not self.token_expiry:
                return True
            return time.time() >= self.token_expiry - 60  # Refresh 1 minute early
        
        def generate_token(self) -> str:
            """Generate a new access token"""
            try:
                credentials = self._encode_credentials()
                response = requests.post(
                    f"{self.base_url}/auth/token",
                    headers={
                        'Authorization': f'Basic {credentials}',
                        'Content-Type': 'application/json'
                    }
                )
                response.raise_for_status()
                
                data = response.json()
                self.access_token = data['data']['access_token']
                self.token_expiry = time.time() + data['data']['expires_in']
                
                return self.access_token
                
            except requests.exceptions.RequestException as e:
                print(f"Error generating token: {e}")
                raise
        
        def get_valid_token(self) -> str:
            """Get a valid access token, generating a new one if needed"""
            if not self.access_token or self._is_token_expired():
                self.generate_token()
            return self.access_token
        
        def make_request(self, method: str, endpoint: str, **kwargs) -> requests.Response:
            """Make an authenticated request to the API"""
            token = self.get_valid_token()
            
            headers = kwargs.get('headers', {})
            headers['Authorization'] = f'Bearer {token}'
            headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'
            kwargs['headers'] = headers
            
            response = requests.request(method, f"{self.base_url}{endpoint}", **kwargs)
            return response
    
    # Usage example
    client = WeirAPIClient(
        username='your_username',
        password='your_password',
        base_url='https://external.example.com'
    )
    
    # Make authenticated requests
    response = client.make_request('GET', '/api/some-endpoint')
    print(response.json())
    ```
